title: Towers & Columns
summary: Fabricated process columns and towers with coordinated internals, materials, transport segmentation and site interfaces.
body:
Tongyang supports fabrication of large process towers and columns to approved drawings and project specifications. Early review of diameter, height, transport limitations and internal arrangements is essential, particularly for equipment requiring shipment in sections.

Typical applications

  • Distillation, absorption and stripping columns
  • Gas treatment and separation tower shells
  • Large column sections for site assembly
  • Columns equipped with trays, packing supports or distributors when specified

Key technical parameters for quotation

  • Geometry: internal diameter, tangent-to-tangent height, head type and overall dimensions
  • Mechanical design: design pressure, vacuum, temperature, wind/seismic loads and material
  • Internals: tray/packing arrangement, support rings, manways and internal attachments
  • Interfaces: nozzle schedule, skirt/support, insulation, lifting and erection points
  • Logistics: transport envelope, shipment sections, site weld scope and inspection access

Fabrication & standards

Plate forming, shell fabrication, welding, inspection and dimensional control are planned according to the approved specification. Pressure design and conformity may follow ASME Section VIII, GB/T 150 or another agreed applicable code. Process separation calculations and internals performance remain the responsibility of the appointed design party unless expressly included.

Quotation basis: provide process/mechanical data sheets, GA and internals drawings. Shop assembly, shipping split, site installation and certification requirements are quoted as clearly defined scope items.
seoDescription: Custom fabricated process towers and columns with trays or packing interfaces, engineered to project drawings, materials and transport constraints.
